name: glass-liquid
description: Clear Liquid Glass over Hokusai's wave: the painting bends through the sidebar, the tab bar and the panes, with the glass lab's dim levels keeping text readable.

files.themes/glass-liquid.json:
// Glass: liquid. The most see-through glass cmux draws: Liquid Glass in its clear style over
// Hokusai's wave, so the painting (and a little of the desktop) bends through the sidebar, the tab
// bar and the panes. Readability comes from a dark dim under each surface, at the levels the glass
// lab measured: 55% under chrome reads 5.2:1 over a bright
// painting, where the 35% dim usually paired with clear glass reads 2.8:1.
{
  "name": "Glass: liquid",
  "description": "Clear Liquid Glass over Hokusai's wave: the painting bends through every surface.",

  "appearance.theme": "Apple System Colors",
  "colors": { "background": "#05080d", "foreground": "#eef3f8", "selection": "#1d3550", "accent": "#7cc4ff" },
  "appearance.accent": "theme",

  // The window: clear Liquid Glass over the painting (Window Glass: the art leads, the desktop
  // shows a little), a light tint, and a third of that tint taken off again.
  "appearance.background": "hokusai-great-wave",
  "appearance.backgroundBlur": "glass-clear",
  "appearance.backgroundOpacity": 0.55,
  "appearance.glassTransparency": 0.25,
  "appearance.wallpaperTint": true,

  // The chrome: a separate sidebar and tab bar, each a 55% black dim over the glass.
  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "separate",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.color": "#000000",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.opacity": 0.55,
  "appearance.surfaces.tabBar.color": "#000000",
  "appearance.surfaces.tabBar.opacity": 0.55,

  // The panes: a deeper dim where you read, the New Tab page and Home almost bare glass.
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.color": "#000000",
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.opacity": 0.65,
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.color": "#000000",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 0.65,
  "appearance.surfaces.newTabPage.color": "#000000",
  "appearance.surfaces.newTabPage.opacity": 0.3,
  "appearance.surfaces.home.color": "#000000",
  "appearance.surfaces.home.opacity": 0.35,

  // The address bar is clear glass too, tinted from the background.
  "browser.omnibar.glass": "clear",
  "browser.omnibar.glassTint": "background",
  "browser.omnibar.glassTintStrength": 0.35,

  // Floating panes with no lines, so only glass separates them.
  "appearance.chromeStyle": "floating",
  "appearance.borders": "none",
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "card",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.style": "arc",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.color": "#7cc4ff"
}
